The name Joanie is also associated with the virtue of graciousness, which is a key aspect of the Christian faith. In modern times, the name Joanie has become popular in many English-speaking countries, including the United States, Canada, and Australia. It is often given to girls born into Christian families, who are looking for a name that reflects their faith and values.
